headlines.title: Has Intuit (INTU) Fallen Far Enough To Look Undervalued On Earnings?
headlines.summary: Intuit has had a rough stretch, with a sharply weaker share price putting fresh attention on whether the current valuation is still supported by its earnings. With the stock now trading at US$331.19, the question for you is how that price lines up with what the business currently earns. Over the past year the share price has fallen 49.7%, which puts the focus squarely on whether investors have reset expectations too far or not far enough relative to Intuit's earnings power.

headlines.title: Intuit to Announce First-Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results on Nov. 19
headlines.summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., October 29, 2026--Intuit Inc. (Nasdaq: INTU), the global financial technology platform that makes TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, Intuit Enterprise Suite and Intuit Accountant Suite will announce its first-quarter results for fiscal year 2027 on November 19, following the close of market. The company’s first quarter ends on October 31.

description: Intuit Inc. provides financial management, payments and capital, compliance, and marketing products and services in the United States. The company operates in two segments: Global Business Solutions and Consumer. Its Global Business Solutions segment provides QuickBooks services, which include financial and business management online services, desktop software, payroll solutions, time tracking, merchant payment processing and bill pay solutions, checking accounts, and financing services for small and mid-market businesses; and Mailchimp, a marketing automation and customer relationship management. The Consumer segment provides TurboTax, a do-it-yourself and assisted income tax preparation products and services; Credit Karma, a personal finance solution that provides recommendations for credit card, home, auto, and personal loan, and insurance products; online savings and checking accounts; and access to its credit scores and reports, credit and identity monitoring, credit report dispute, credit building tools, debt pay-down assistance, credit card rewards optimization, and connected account capabilities. This segment also offers ProTax offerings which include Lacerte, ProSeries, and ProFile desktop tax-preparation software products; and ProConnect Tax Online, electronic tax filing service, and bank products and related services. It sells products and services through direct sales channels, multichannel shop-and-buy experiences, online application stores, and partner and other channels. Intuit Inc. has a strategic collaboration with Aprio, LLP to develop AI-powered solutions designed to help identify tax planning opportunities, benchmark business performance, improve financial visibility, and support more informed decision-making across industries, including construction, dental, wealth management, and tax. Intuit Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
